tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun bzang thugs gter las yang dag zhi khro phur gsum gyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ /chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /las kyi dbang mo rig 'dzin rnam brgyad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs o rgyan thod phreng rtsal/ /gnub kyi slob dpon nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ /gang gi rnam 'phrul byang chub gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /padma'i zhal skyin mdo sngags gling pa dang*/ /mdzod lnga'i shing rta blo gros pha mtha' yas/ /rig 'dzin 'gyur med tshe dbang rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /gdod ma'i mgon po chos kyi blo gros dang*/ /gar gyi dbang phyug rab gsal zla ba'i mtshan/ /'jam dbyangs thub bstan chos kyi rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /yi dam yang dag zhi khro phur pa'i lha/ /phrin las mnga' bdag mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /sna tshogs snang ba lha yi 'khor lor dag /grags pa'i sgra kun yi ge'i dal du rdzogs/ /rtog pa'i rba rlabs thugs su smin pa yi/ /bskyed rim pha mthar son par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa thig rlung gi rgyu ba las su rung*/ /bde stong pho nya'i zab lam nyams 'og chud/ /mtshon bya don gyi ye shes mngon gyur te/ /rdzogs rim lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang stong pa'i dbyings su zhig /zang thal rig pa rtog pa'i gzeb las grol/ /zung 'jug rjen par myong ba'i nyams len gyis/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces pa'ang 2008 tshes bco lnga la rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos kyi grwa chen por 'di dag gi smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa 'bogs pa'i g.yar khral lhur len pa'i srod kyi thun la phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas gsol ba btab pa dge legs 'phel/
